tasks.name: Survival Systems Design
tasks.objective: Produce the Survival Systems Design for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every need listed with drain rate, threshold and consequence
Hazard, disease and injury tables with numbers
Crop, wildlife and regeneration cycles stated in in-game time
Accessibility options for survival pressure defined

tasks.name: Survival Systems Implementation
tasks.objective: Produce the Survival Systems Implementation for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every need, hazard and consumable behaves to the tables
Wildlife and crops cycle correctly over in-game time
Survival state persists correctly across save and load

tasks.name: Survival Balance Review
tasks.objective: Produce the Survival Balance Review for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Time-to-death from each pressure source measured and inside design range
No resource loop trivialises survival in a long simulation
